theorem np_bench_Finset_sum_Ico_by_parts : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : ℕ → R) (g : ℕ → M)
  {m n : ℕ},
  m < n →
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, f i • g i =
      f (n - 1) • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g i - f m • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, g i -
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m (n - 1), (f (i + 1) - f i) • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), g i

theorem np_bench_Finset_sum_range_by_parts' : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : ℕ → R) (g : ℕ → M)
  (n : ℕ),
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i • g i =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) • g (n - 1) -
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), f j) • (g (i + 1) - g i)
